correctness.rationale: For the explicitly specified open Michaelis–Menten full LNA and its one-substrate heuristic LNA, drift J=[[-a,v],[h,-v]] with a=u+d+k>0,h=u+d,v=k0e, determinant vk>0; diffusion covariance (c/Ω)[[2(d+k),-(2d+k)],[-(2d+k),2(d+k)]]. Stationary OU PSD via (iωI-J)^-1 D(-iωI-Jᵀ)^-1 yields S_full=(2c/Ω)[(d+k)ω²+k(ha+k(d+k))]/[(vk-ω²)²+(a+v)²ω²], S_heur=(2kc/Ω)/(ω²+(vk/a)²). Their difference has numerator -dω⁴+Bω²+C0 with B,C0>0, verified by independent symbolic resolvent algebra. Thus one ω*>0 crossing if d>0, strict heuristic excess for all finite ω if d=0; high-ω sign reverses only for d>0. Gaussian LNA statement, not exact CME or validated physical high-frequency QSSA.
